before: Maybe what they can do is text you something kind the next day and not bring any of it up.
guide_passage: Keep that assessment specific and revisable. Someone disagreeing with you, needing time, or setting their own boundary does not make them emotionally immature. You may not know whether they cannot respond differently, will not, or cannot right now. You can still decide what you cannot currently rely on. Update that judgment when their behavior changes—not merely when they promise. And you do not need repeated exposure to danger before protecting yourself.
next: Notice your side too. Feeling guilty does not prove that you did something wrong; it also does not prove that somebody manipulated you. Did you cause harm that needs repair, or are you abandoning your position to make their disappointment go away? Sometimes both are present.
